description.text: The Portuguese print of this alternate-art card came only in Brazil's Baralhos Arena de Batalha: Kyurem Preto vs. Kyurem Branco, the local release of the Battle Arena Decks: Black Kyurem vs. White Kyurem, sold from 29 September 2017. One of the two decks holds it as a plain card and the other as a Holofoil one.

tell.text: No foil anywhere on the card.
